title: Ingeniero de Calidad Proveedores SSR (Industria Automotriz)
description:
Ingeniero de Calidad Proveedores SSR (Industria Automotriz)

Para nuestro cliente, un importante grupo empresario con múltiples Unidades de Negocio (Manufactura, Retail, Logística, Distribución, Innovación, Agropecuario y Servicios), buscamos un Ingeniero Calidad Proveedores SSR.

La Compañía se encuentra en plena expansión, contexto que favorece las oportunidades de desarrollo y crecimiento profesional.

La posición reportará al responsable del área y sus funciones principales serán:

  • Solicitar, analizar y gestionar la aprobación de las primeras muestras de proveedores y la documentación asociada (Documentación PPAP/ carpetas de primeras muestras).
  • Elaborar y mantener los indicadores de gestión bajo su responsabilidad y su plan de mejora asociado.
  • Gestión de no conformidades. Informar a los proveedores sobre las no conformidades detectadas, realizar el seguimiento, analizar y validar las acciones de mejora que aseguren la no reincidencia.
  • Administrar el recupero económico de los costos de no calidad de los proveedores.
  • Realizar el seguimiento y control de la vigencia de las certificaciones de calidad de los proveedores.
  • Planificar y ejecutar auditorías de procesos y sistema de gestión a proveedores buscando asegurar la Calidad de los productos y/o Servicios que proporcionan y el cuidado del Medio Ambiente.

Requisitos:

  • Formación: Ingeniero/a o estudiante avanzado de Ing. Electrónica, Ing. Mecánica, Ing. Industrial, Ing. Aeronáutica (excluyente).
  • Contar con al menos 3 años de experiencia en posiciones similares (excluyente).
  • Experiencia en la industria automotriz (deseable).
  • Conocimientos técnicos de la industria: Core Tools - APQP - PPAP - IATF- otros. (excluyente).
  • Manejo de Office intermedio / avanzado. Conocimiento SAP. SharePoint.
  • Dominio del idioma inglés intermedio - avanzado (debe poder leer, escribir y mantener conversaciones con proveedores - excluyente). Se valorará el conocimiento de un tercer idioma (Portugués deseable).

Beneficios:

  • Bono en base a cumplimiento de objetivos.
  • OSDE 210 (grupo familiar).
  • Descuentos en gimnasios.
  • Tarjeta de alimentos.
  • Mix trabajo presencial - remoto.

Buscamos profesionales proactivos, organizados, con sólida capacidad analítica, pensamiento crítico, excelentes habilidades comunicativas, trabajo en equipo, capacidad de adaptación y destreza en negociación.

Lugar de trabajo: sede administrativa - Belgrano, Provincia de Buenos Aires, Argentina

Jornada laboral: Lunes a viernes 08 hs a 17 hs

title: Analista Fiscal Junior
description:
Estamos em busca de um Analista Fiscal para integrar nossa equipe e atuar no acompanhamento e gestão de atividades fiscais e tributárias, garantindo conformidade com as legislações vigentes e contribuindo para a eficiência dos processos internos.


Principais atividades:

  1. Apuração de Impostos: Realizar a apuração correta dos impostos, considerando legislações e alíquotas aplicáveis;
  2. Declarações Fiscais: Acompanhar o envio de declarações fiscais periódicas, como SPED, DCTF e outras obrigações acessórias;
  3. Controle de Documentos Fiscais: Organizar e verificar a regularidade de documentos fiscais, como notas fiscais eletrônicas (NF-e) e de entradas e saídas;
  4. Assessoria Tributária: Prestar suporte à contabilidade e ao setor financeiro, orientando sobre classificação de tributos e interpretação da legislação tributária;
  5. Revisão de Processos Fiscais: Revisar processos internos, conferindo impostos pagos, analisando créditos tributários e corrigindo possíveis erros em lançamentos fiscais.

Requisitos:

  1. Graduação em Contabilidade, Administração ou cursos técnicos em Gestão Fiscal ou Contabilidade.
  2. Legislação Tributária: Conhecimento intermediário da legislação tributária vigente (federal, estadual e municipal) e do Sistema Público de Escrituração Digital (SPED).
  3. Impostos e Contribuições: Domínio sobre ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, IRPJ, CSLL e suas formas de apuração.
  4. Obrigações Acessórias: Experiência na elaboração e entrega de DCTF, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contribuições, DIRF, GFIP e outras obrigações acessórias.

title: AUXILIAR DE LOGISTICA - Serra/ES - Noturno
description:
Responsável por realizar a conferência, separação, movimentação, estoque, abastecimento e disponibilização dos produtos para entrega dos clientes.
Atividades:

  • Conferir as ordens de expedição para garantir que todas as mercadorias sejam corretamente selecionadas e atendam aos requisitos do pedido.
  • Verificar se os produtos estão devidamente etiquetados, com a documentação fiscal correta, como notas fiscais e manifestos de carga.
  • Organizar e preparar a carga para expedição, garantindo que os produtos estejam prontos para o envio conforme as especificações (quantidade, tipo e características).
  • Separar e agrupar as mercadorias de acordo com os pedidos, destinos ou clientes, assegurando que a carga seja entregue sem erros.
  • Armazenar temporariamente as mercadorias no local adequado dentro da área de expedição, de forma ordenada, até o momento do despacho.
  • Garantir que a carga esteja acessível e bem organizada, facilitando o processo de carregamento e despacho.
  • Carregar os produtos nos veículos de transporte, garantindo que o carregamento seja feito de maneira eficiente e dentro das normas de segurança.
  • Distribuir as cargas de forma equilibrada nos veículos para evitar danos e otimizar o espaço disponível.
  • Checar e organizar a documentação de expedição, incluindo notas fiscais, documentos de transporte e relatórios de carga.
  • Assegurar que todos os documentos estejam corretos e acompanhem a mercadoria durante o transporte para evitar problemas com a entrega.
  • Garantir que as normas de segurança sejam seguidas durante a preparação, carregamento e despacho da carga, evitando acidentes e danos aos produtos.
  • Acompanhar os procedimentos de segurança, incluindo o uso de equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) e o manuseio correto de cargas pesadas ou frágeis.
  • Manter a área de expedição limpa e organizada, garantindo que todos os materiais, como paletes e caixas, sejam bem armazenados e de fácil acesso.
  • Organizar os equipamentos de trabalho, como carrinhos, empilhadeiras ou paleteiras, para garantir um ambiente de trabalho eficiente e seguro.

You will work alongside our best engineers on developing and adapting our devices to meet strict international criteria, aiding the company in its mission to modernize the factory floor worldwide.

  • Identify and interpret applicable certification requirements and develop strategies to achieve and maintain compliance.
,

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.

  • Expertise in FCC, CE, IFT, UL Markings, IEC, and other regulatory compliance standards.
  • Experience with IECEx, ATEX, and other hazardous locations certifications.
  • Strong understanding of safety and functioning electronics standards and certifications such as IEC 61010 and IEC 61557-12.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 procedures and requirements.

  • Fluent English proficiency.

  • Elaborar e acompanhar o plano de vendas da empresa, definindo metas de vendas por produto, região e canal, monitorando o desempenho em relação às metas e propondo ajustes quando necessário, para garantir o alcance dos objetivos de vendas da empresa.
  • Realizar análises de mercado, estudando o comportamento dos consumidores, a concorrência e as tendências do mercado, para identificar oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolver estratégias de vendas eficazes.
  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos de previsão de vendas, utilizando técnicas estatísticas e ferramentas de análise de dados, para prever a demanda futura e otimizar o planejamento de produção e estoque.
  • Monitorar e analisar os indicadores de desempenho de vendas (KPIs), como volume de vendas, margem de lucro, participação de mercado e taxa de conversão, para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e acompanhar o progresso em relação às metas.
  • Realizar análises de rentabilidade de produtos e clientes, identificando os produtos e clientes mais rentáveis e propondo ações para otimizar a rentabilidade da empresa.
  • Elaborar relatórios e apresentações gerenciais, consolidando dados de vendas, análises de mercado e previsões de vendas, para fornecer informações claras e concisas para a tomada de decisões da equipe de vendas e da alta gestão.
  • Colaborar com as áreas de marketing, produtos e finanças, fornecendo informações e análises que subsidiem o desenvolvimento de estratégias de marketing, o lançamento de novos produtos e o planejamento financeiro da empresa.
  • Acompanhar a performance das campanhas de vendas, analisando os resultados das campanhas, identificando os canais e ações mais eficazes e propondo ajustes para otimizar o retorno sobre o investimento.
  • Identificar e analisar oportunidades de expansão de mercado, avaliando o potencial de novos mercados, canais de vendas e parcerias estratégicas, para contribuir para o crescimento da empresa.

Requisitos:

About Payoneer
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 markets.
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance, to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
As an HR Business Partner (HRBP), you will be a strategic advisor to senior functional leaders, translating business goals into people strategies and helping shape high-performing, inclusive, and scalable teams. You’ll partner closely with People Partners, COEs, and the HRBP leadership team to ensure your business area is aligned, engaged, and supported across performance, talent, structure, and change. This is a key role focused on strategic impact, leadership enablement, and driving business outcomes through people.
What You’ll Be Spending Your Time On

  • Business Partnership & Leadership Support Act as a trusted advisor to functional leaders, enabling them to build high-performing, engaged teams. Provide insight and guidance on org effectiveness, talent planning, team dynamics, and leader development.
  • Strategic Talent Planning Partner with business leaders and Talent COEs to anticipate talent needs, identify gaps, and drive long-term plans around workforce, skills, and succession.
  • Organizational Design & Change Lead org design discussions for your functions, shaping structures that support scale, clarity, and accountability. Manage change and communication planning in partnership with People Partners and the business.
  • Performance & Culture Strengthen accountability, transparency, and manager effectiveness through coaching, feedback, and aligned performance processes. Champion company culture and ways of working across your business unit.
  • HR Program Leadership Localize and embed key people programs (e.g., engagement, performance, compensation) in partnership with People Partners, ensuring they’re applied consistently and with business relevance.
  • Insights & Decision Support Leverage people data (headcount, attrition, engagement, performance) to surface insights and shape strategy. Influence leadership decisions with clear, data-backed recommendations.
  • Partnering with People Partners Work hand-in-hand with People Partners who own day-to-day manager and employee support. Provide escalation, coaching, and strategic context to ensure excellent delivery across the employee lifecycle.
Role Requirements
  • 5–7 years of HR experience, with at least 2 years supporting senior leaders or executives.
  • Experience in org design, talent planning, and strategic business partnership.
  • Experience managing different employment structures (e.g. Employee of Record, Full Time Consultants) in LATAM.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to derive insights and influence decisions.
  • Excellent judgment and comfort handling sensitive issues with discretion.
  • Ability to coach leaders, challenge thoughtfully, and offer clear guidance.
  • Strong collaboration skills — able to work across HR disciplines and with global stakeholders.
  • Resilient, proactive, and solutions-oriented — with a bias for clarity and action.
  • Deep understanding of core HR processes and how they connect to business outcomes.
  • Alignment with our ways of working: Act as Our Customer’s Partner, Do It and Own It, Continuously Improve, Build Each Other Up.
Why join us?
  • Be part of a forward-thinking company that values your contributions and supports your professional growth.
  • Work in a collaborative and inclusive environment where your ideas and insights are valued.
  • Enjoy opportunities for continuous learning and development.
  • Make a meaningful impact on the employee and manager experience and contribute to our company's success.
If you are passionate about HR, thrive in a dynamic environment, and are ready to take on a challenging and rewarding role, we would love to hear from you!
Join the Payoneer Family - check out Our Values and apply today!

title: Manager Americas - Customer Success
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Manager Americas - Customer Success role at Canonical

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Manager Americas - Customer Success role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Customer Success Regional Team Manager.
To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to help our team of Customer Success Managers across regions. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success and an obvious passion for new technologies. Ideally, you have been a Customer Success Manager at one point in your career and naturally evolved to a leading position.
You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you are to provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. You are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and quickly adapt to changes. You seek collaboration with other teams to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility is to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work hand-in-hand with the Head of Customer Success.
CSMs engage a diverse customer base and follow diverse CSM motions to provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer. The right candidate would adapt to this diversity and bring broad experience to the team.
Location: This is a globally remote role
The role entails:

  • Strategic planning and analysis: preparing communication plans, Team Meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive upsells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.
  • Customer interactions and support to your team: you resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention. You work closely with your team members to ensure timely resolution.
  • Team management: you are passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. You are ready for regular performance reviews with team members. While your help in identifying areas for improvement is key, you are asked to celebrate excellence, recognise your team's achievements, and set goals for individual growth within the team.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.
  • Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.
What we are looking for in you
  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM
  • Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries
  • Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
  • Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration
  • Experience growing and developing a CSM team
  • Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice-to-have skills
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Product owner
description:
Estamos em busca de um Product Owner altamente motivado e focado em resultados para liderar o desenvolvimento de soluções inovadoras de crédito com garantias. O candidato ideal será responsável por definir e priorizar o backlog de produtos, trabalhar diretamente com as equipes de desenvolvimento e garantir que nossas soluções atendam às necessidades dos clientes e do negócio. Além disso, terá um papel fundamental na validação de hipóteses, utilizando testes e experimentos para tomar decisões baseadas em dados e aprimorar continuamente o produto.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Definir e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo que as funcionalidades entreguem valor ao cliente e ao negócio.
  • Colaborar com as partes interessadas internas (executivos, marketing, vendas, suporte ao cliente) para alinhamento da visão do produto e definição de prioridades.
  • Desenvolver e conduzir testes e experimentos para validar hipóteses de funcionalidades, utilizando abordagens como testes A/B, MVPs (Produto Mínimo Viável) e outras técnicas de validação.
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio e de usuários em histórias claras e detalhadas para o time de desenvolvimento, com critérios de aceitação bem definidos.
  • Monitorar e analisar os resultados de testes para determinar o sucesso das hipóteses e ajustar o backlog com base em dados concretos e insights obtidos.
  • Gerenciar o roadmap do produto, garantindo que as entregas estejam alinhadas às necessidades estratégicas da empresa e do mercado.
  • Trabalhar com a metodologia ágil (Scrum/Kanban), liderando cerimônias como refinamento de backlog, sprint planning e revisões de sprint.
  • Validar as entregas com base nos critérios de aceitação e feedback de usuários, garantindo que os produtos estejam prontos para o lançamento.
  • Monitorar o desempenho do produto pós-lançamento, coletando feedback de usuários e analisando métricas para guiar melhorias contínuas.
  • Realizar pesquisas de mercado e análise de concorrentes, identificando oportunidades para inovação e crescimento.
  • Ser a ponte entre o time de desenvolvimento e os stakeholders, garantindo comunicação clara e transparente sobre o progresso do produto e suas métricas.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia como Product Owner ou em funções de gestão de produtos digitais, preferencialmente em fintechs ou empresas de tecnologia.
  • Habilidade para desenvolver e validar hipóteses de produto através de experimentos controlados, como testes A/B, protótipos e MVPs.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e experiência em liderar equipes de desenvolvimento.
  • Forte entendimento do mercado de crédito, especialmente crédito com garantias, e das tendências regulatórias e tecnológicas que o impactam.
  • Habilidade em priorizar funcionalidades com base em impacto de negócios, valor para o usuário e complexidade técnica.
  • Experiência em analisar dados e métricas de produtos para tomar decisões baseadas em resultados de experimentos e feedbacks de usuários.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e liderança, com capacidade de colaborar com equipes multifuncionais e gerenciar expectativas de stakeholders.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de backlog e projetos, como Jira, Trello, ou Asana.
  • Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

O que oferecemos:

Cartão Flash Turbinado para refeição e/ou alimentação.

The role of a Cloud Field Engineering Manager at Canonical
The Field Engineering team is our team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical, working directly with our customers, designing private and public cloud solutions fitting their workload needs. The portfolio of products includes on-premise cloud solutions such as Openstack, MicroCloud and Ceph, and solutions that could be deployed either on-premises or in public clouds such as Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL, etc. The team works hands-on with the technologies by deploying, testing and handing over the solution to our support or managed services team at the end of a project. Managers and team members also take part in presales conversations to provide technical advice during the sales process.
A Cloud Field Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role. You are also expected to actively participate in technical presales to help our department achieve our quarterly goals.
Location: This role will be home based, managing a team in your time zone.
What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
What we are looking for in you
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies, such as Kubernetes, Openstack, AWS, GCP, Azure, Ceph, etc.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux and networking
  • Experience in technical presales
  • You are a dynamic person who loves to jump in new projects and interact with people
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Passion and a track record of developing and growing people
  • Experience in leading, coaching and mentoring engineers
  • Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and, preferably, university as well
  • Willingness to travel up to 40% of the time. Field Engineers attend internal company events, external tech events and customer meetings.
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • Second language - Spanish or French preferred
  • Python knowledge
  • Experience collaborating with external partners
  • Experience collaborating with several internal teams and providing stakeholder feedback for engineering roadmaps
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Analista fiscal de contabilidade
description:
O cargo de Analista Fiscal em uma empresa de contabilidade envolve a responsabilidade por atividades relacionadas à apuração e controle de tributos, com foco no cumprimento das obrigações fiscais e tributárias das empresas clientes. O analista fiscal desempenha um papel fundamental na gestão das obrigações fiscais, garantindo que os tributos sejam calculados corretamente e pagos dentro dos prazos estabelecidos pela legislação.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Apuração de Tributos: Calcular e controlar tributos como ICMS, IPI, ISS, PIS, COFINS, IRPJ, CSLL, entre outros, conforme a legislação vigente.
  2. Preenchimento de Obrigações Acessórias: Elaborar e transmitir as declarações fiscais, como DCTF, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contribuições, DIRF, entre outras.
  3. Análise de Documentos Fiscais: Verificar a regularidade dos documentos fiscais recebidos (notas fiscais de entrada e saída), garantindo que os mesmos estejam de acordo com as exigências legais.
  4. Consultoria Fiscal: Prestar suporte e orientação aos clientes sobre questões fiscais, como o enquadramento tributário mais vantajoso, mudanças na legislação e procedimentos para regularização de pendências fiscais.
  5. Apuração de Impostos Diretos e Indiretos: Realizar a apuração de impostos sobre a produção e circulação de mercadorias e serviços, bem como impostos sobre a renda e contribuições.
  6. Controle de Créditos e Débitos Fiscais: Gerenciar os créditos tributários gerados pelas compras e serviços prestados e garantir que sejam utilizados corretamente para compensação de tributos devidos.
  7. Acompanhamento de Mudanças na Legislação Fiscal: Manter-se atualizado sobre as mudanças na legislação tributária e fiscal, implementando as alterações necessárias nos processos da empresa e repassando as informações para os clientes.
  8. Acompanhamento de Auditorias Fiscais: Auxiliar na preparação para auditorias fiscais, garantindo que toda a documentação e os registros estejam em conformidade.
  9. Regularização de Pendências Fiscais: Auxiliar na negociação de parcelamentos e regularização de pendências fiscais com o fisco.

Requisitos:

  1. Formação: Ensino superior completo em Contabilidade, Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  2. Conhecimentos: Domínio das obrigações fiscais e tributárias, sistemas de gestão contábil e fiscal, SPED, EFD, DCTF, entre outras ferramentas.
  3. Experiência: Experiência prévia em escritórios de contabilidade, departamentos fiscais ou em empresas de grande porte.
  4. Habilidades: Atenção aos detalhes, organização, capacidade analítica e habilidades de comunicação.

Esse cargo exige profissional com boa capacidade de análise, habilidades para lidar com a legislação tributária complexa e uma comunicação eficaz, além de ser um elo importante entre a empresa e o fisco.

title: Concept Artist
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is seeking an experienced Concept Artist to join our team working on Fortnite, Rocket League, and Rocket Racing. A successful candidate should possess a strong sense of vehicle design, knowledge of 3D software, and a solid foundation in art theories. Must be a team player and demonstrate the ability to be self-motivated and work autonomously. The role involves working closely with the Art Director and Lead Concept Artist to create appealing vehicle designs and environments. The candidate will collaborate with the art team to implement and sustain the creative vision for the game.

In this role, you will

  1. Produce artwork encompassing all facets of development, including vehicle designs, environments, props, VFX exploration, pitch concepts, and marketing materials based on direction from Art Director, Lead Concept, and input from the game design team.
  2. Based on visual direction from the Art Director, collaborate on the visual style and ensure our designs are of Epic quality bar create and iterate unique and stunning designs within a determined production schedule.
  3. A versatile artist capable of executing a variety of styles and able to pivot based on the needs of the project.
  4. Collaborate with other discipline teams to produce a cohesive game experience.

What we're looking for

  1. An eye for modern automotive aesthetics that speak to our audience of teens and young adults.
  2. Ability to work within gameplay design restraints (environment scale, character abilities, prototype function, etc.) and translate those restrictions into visuals that enhance the experience.
  3. Experience creating art from mechanical designs to exciting arena sports environments.
  4. Experience in 3D software such as Maya, Blender, and/or Zbrush.
  5. Excellent foundation skills, including composition, design, and color theory, and advanced knowledge of industrial design.
  6. Experienced in working with external outsourcing vendors.
  7. An excellent understanding of art pipelines.
  8. Strong communication skills and understanding of various art disciplines.

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Coordenadora/Coordenador de Integridade e Confiabilidade Filtragem - Vaga exclusiva para pessoas negras

Está em busca de um futuro emocionante? Então, nós temos uma excelente oportunidade.

Na Anglo American, acreditamos em resultados extraordinários. Isso significa que estamos sempre procurando novas e melhores maneiras de fazer as coisas, forjando um novo curso em nosso setor para maior eficiência, zero dano e maior sustentabilidade.

Guiados por nosso objetivo e valores, promovemos alto desempenho e ação com propósito, pois nosso objetivo é "Reimaginar a mineração para melhorar a vida das pessoas", fornecendo metais e minerais que possibilitam a vida moderna, desde telefones a medicamentos.

Estamos transformando nossas operações questionando o pensamento existente e aplicando novas ideias e avanços tecnológicos para enfrentar os principais desafios da mineração. Inovamos com um objetivo: buscar novas maneiras de trabalhar que sejam mais seguras e responsáveis, focando na saúde e bem-estar de nossos colegas e das comunidades onde atuamos.

No Brasil, atuamos com dois negócios: Minério de ferro, com Minas-Rio, localizado em Minas Gerais e Rio de Janeiro; e Níquel, com operações em Barro Alto e Niquelândia, Goiás. Além disso, temos uma estrutura corporativa em Belo Horizonte.

Estamos buscando talentos que compartilhem nossos valores e crença em um futuro melhor, mais seguro, diverso e respeitoso para a mineração. Você pode ser um deles!

Como Coordenador(a) de Integridade e Confiabilidade Filtragem , você será responsável por coordenar os processos de priorização, planejamento e execução das atividades de integridade estrutural da filtragem, realizados por equipe própria e terceirizada. Também garantirá a disponibilidade, integridade e desempenho dos ativos da planta, aplicando metodologias de confiabilidade (RCM, FMEA, análise de falhas) e estratégias de manutenção preditiva e preventiva. Atuará na identificação e mitigação de riscos operacionais, desenvolvendo planos de manutenção baseados na criticidade, liderando investigações de falhas, propondo melhorias técnicas e coordenando inspeções técnicas especializadas. Trabalhará de forma integrada com áreas de engenharia, operação e segurança, assegurando conformidade com normas técnicas, desempenho sustentável dos equipamentos e suporte à tomada de decisão com base em dados e indicadores de performance.

Veja abaixo as principais atividades:

  1. Coordenar a equipe de preditiva e planejamento, além da execução de atividades relacionadas à integridade estrutural.
  2. Elaborar e manter planos de integridade baseados na criticidade dos ativos e na segurança.
  3. Investigar falhas estruturais ou mecânicas, conduzindo análises de falha e elaboração de planos de ação corretivos.
  4. Definir e revisar estratégias de manutenção baseada em condição (CBM), utilizando vibração, ultrassom, termografia, entre outros.
  5. Avaliar a criticidade estrutural dos ativos e priorizar intervenções conforme matriz de risco.
  6. Aplicar ferramentas como RCM (Reliability Centered Maintenance) e FMEA para melhorar a disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos equipamentos.
  7. Acompanhar KPIs como MTBF, MTTR, disponibilidade estrutural, backlog de manutenção, número de inspeções realizadas versus planejadas, etc.
  8. Capacitar a equipe de manutenção e operação em práticas seguras e eficazes para garantir a integridade dos ativos.
  9. Manter atualizados desenhos, laudos de inspeção, relatórios de integridade, certificados e históricos de manutenção.
  10. Atuar proativamente junto à operação para reportar anomalias e mitigar riscos à segurança e continuidade operacional.
  11. Colaborar na elaboração e controle do orçamento de manutenção e inspeção de ativos estruturais e de confiabilidade.
  12. Implementar melhorias contínuas nos processos de manutenção e operação.
  13. Coordenar a equipe, realizando controle de ponto, reuniões de feedback, análises de promoções e movimentações salariais, entre outras atividades de gestão.
  14. Cumprir as políticas e procedimentos de Segurança, Saúde Operacional, Meio Ambiente, Responsabilidade Social e Integridade Empresarial da Anglo American.

O perfil que buscamos:

  • Ensino Superior em Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica, Produção ou Automação.
  • Desejável Mestrado em Engenharia de Manutenção, Pós-graduação em Engenharia de Manutenção ou Estruturas.

Por que fazer parte do nosso time?

Somos uma empresa comprometida em transformar nossas crenças e valores em ações concretas. Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho de qualidade, diverso e seguro, onde você pode desenvolver seu potencial. Conheça nossos benefícios:

  • Para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental: Gympass, Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (para você e dependentes), Assistência Psicológica e Aplicativo Saúde Emocional.
  • Para sua família: Auxílio Creche, Programa Família, Brinquedo de Natal e Vale Alimentação.
  • Espaço para ser você mesmo: participação em Grupos de Afinidades e eventos da Semana da Diversidade.
  • Plano de Previdência Privada, transporte fretado, refeições no local, remuneração variável, Seguro de Vida, apoio jurídico, financeiro, social e psicológico.

Compromisso com sua segurança:

Priorizamos sua segurança, investindo em tecnologias e seguindo rigorosos padrões de segurança para garantir que você volte para casa em segurança após o trabalho.

Inclusão e Diversidade:

Valorizamos e respeitamos todas as identidades e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, com Grupos de Afinidades para discutir e promover ações de diversidade e inclusão.

Queremos colegas que se sintam valorizados, respeitados e confiantes para trazer seu verdadeiro eu ao trabalho.

Para candidatar-se, cadastre-se online e anexe seu currículo. Nosso processo inclui inscrição, análise de currículos, dinâmica/entrevista, avaliação comportamental, exame médico e admissão. Fique atento às comunicações por e-mail, telefone ou WhatsApp.

Se identificou? Então vem cooperar conosco!


Main responsibilities

  • Acompanhar o ciclo de vida dos normativos da Diretoria, com foco na atualização tempestiva, no controle de vigência, na aprovação formal e na divulgação institucional, assegurando que os responsáveis conduzam as etapas conforme os prazos e diretrizes estabelecidos;

  • Atuar com visão transversal e capacidade de interlocução com diferentes públicos, promovendo sinergia entre a Diretoria de Riscos e as demais estruturas organizacionais;
  • Mapear tendências, visitar cooperativas e trazer referências práticas que promovam inovação, oxigenação e diferenciação para a atuação da Diretoria;

description:
Senior Data Analyst – Money Markets Data

Location: (Insert Location)

Business Area: Data

Ref #: 10039966

Description & Requirements

At Bloomberg, our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock – from around the world. In Data, we’re responsible for delivering this data, news and analytics through innovative technology - quickly and accurately.

Our Team:

In 2023, US Money Market Funds (MMF) held $6.1 trillion in AUM and Non-US MMFs held an additional $1.2 trillion in AUM. This is a growing market given the increased rates environment and fund inflows have reached all-time levels. As a result, we have seen higher demand for this data from clients and are creating a new dedicated global Money Markets data team to address the opportunities in this space.

What's the Role?

As a Data Analyst with our team, you will be responsible for the acquisition, maintenance, and quality assurance of money markets instruments data. This will entail engagement with Issuers and Dealers to source and validate data, close collaboration with the data engineers on the team to ensure automated processes work as expected, provide support to clients with complex data queries, and work on various data quality and data modeling projects. Joining the Data department means that you are a part of one of the world's leading sources of data, providing accurate, immediate insights for financial market professionals. You will enhance your product knowledge, learn about our clients and their needs, and build relationships throughout the company, all while helping our clients stay on top of developments within Money Markets globally.

You're the type of person who looks beyond the headline with a keen eye for detail because you know how data inspires market trends, breaking news, and analysis. With ever-increasing coverage and demand for timely data, you will be responsible for managing priorities of different initiatives and for utilizing industry knowledge to help drive decisions and generate new dataset offerings. You will need to know your customer, their challenges, and their workflows. With this insight, you will bring creative ideas to the table on how we can make our data integration seamless and more efficient.

We’ll trust you to:

  1. Have knowledge in Fixed income and an interest in Money Markets specifically.
  2. Have experience working with data and an understanding of data quality best practices.
  3. Liaise with Clearing Houses, Central Banks, Exchanges, Dealers, and Issuers to ensure comprehensive and accurate data offerings.
  4. Effectively collaborate with other internal departments, such as Product, Engineering, and News on dataset product development initiatives.
  5. Develop expertise in local markets across the Americas.
  6. Apply problem-solving and data analysis skills to identify innovative workflow efficiencies and implement solutions to enhance our processes/overall product strategy.
  7. Collaborate with Sales to promote Money Markets data using the relevant subject matter expertise and use knowledge gained from client interactions to enhance the dataset.
  8. Assist our world-renowned client support help desk with client inquiries.
  9. Collaborate with global counterparts to evolve the role, workflow, and operating procedures to ensure consistency in data quality and timeliness across regions.

You’ll need to have:

  1. Minimum 4+ years of experience working with financial data, preferably within the Fixed income asset class.
  2. Fluency in English and Portuguese.
  3. Demonstrated data management experience such as running data quality initiatives, overseeing data governance, and implementing best practices with regards to data acquisition and updates.
  4. Experience in client engagement and excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially when explaining technical processes and solutions to business partners and management. Proficiency in English. Knowledge of Spanish and/or Portuguese is a plus.
  5. A bachelor's degree or higher in data technology or financial field, or degree-equivalent qualification.
  6. Be comfortable with a high degree of autonomy and managing priorities from multiple internal and external partners.
  7. Demonstrated ability to take a logical approach and apply critical thinking skills in order to solve problems.
  8. Strong collaboration skills and experience working as part of a multi-location team.

We’d love to see:

  1. Project management experience, particularly in Agile framework.
  2. Fluency in Spanish.
  3. Interest in technology.
  4. Knowledge of statistical analysis and demonstrated applied data analysis skills, with proficiency using Excel. Experience in SQL and/or Python is a plus.
  5. Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

title: Delivery Leader (Brazil) LAC
description:
Delivery Associates (DA) is a global consultancy helping the public sector deliver lasting impact through effective implementation. With roots in Deliverology and over a decade of experience, we support leaders from strategy to execution. Our remote team works worldwide with governments and philanthropies to scale results.

We’re committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion—believing empowered, diverse teams drive stronger partnerships and more equitable outcomes.

Description

Location: Recife, Brazil (candidates should be based or be willing to reallocate to Recife for the rest of 2025).

Delivery Associates work with leaders in the public sector and impact organizations to solve problems, build consensus and implement policies and programs that impact millions of people. We use a clear methodology to solve problems and help our partners deliver results. We’re successful in part because we master our approach and in part because we are empathetic, resourceful, level-headed, and dedicated to our clients and the people they serve

As a Delivery Leader, you’ll work with our partners (in government, in philanthropy, and at multilateral and nonprofit organizations). You are comfortable building and leading direct client relationships, drafting materials based on client need and feedback from other DA team members, and being both proactive and reactive within a typical professional services client project context.

Skill Sets.

We work closely in diverse, global teams, leaning on each other’s strengths. We don’t expect any one person to do all these things perfectly. Our Delivery Leaders should be able to:

● Ability to build capacity on data use for decision making: Support government partners to improve their data capacities and practices effectively.

● Build and lead relationships: Earn trust and influence among diverse stakeholders, especially in the public sector, philanthropy, or nonprofit world.

● Facilitate and coach: Run effective meetings and workshops that drive towards problem solving and consensus.

● Model and analyze data: Turn raw data into actionable insights and recommendations, whether through Excel or other platforms.

● Write and present clearly: Turn complex problems or insights into clear documents and well-structured slides; speak clearly and concisely in remote and in-person settings.

● Prioritize and manage projects: Bring clear structure and planning to day-to-day work and communication.

● Solve problems: Break down problems and identify root causes before developing hypotheses and solutions.

● Stay focused: Navigate complexity, especially in policy and program implementation, consistently steering large coalitions back to a single-minded focus on priority outcomes.

Mindsets.

We work well with people who are:

● Adaptable: Public sector work is dynamic. Our people are, too.

● Analytical: We identify, dissect, and solve complex problems, following the data and evidence.

● Accountable: We are a remote team. We work collaboratively but self-sufficiently; oversight is often minimal, while proactivity is essential.

● Driven: Our work is important, so it’s important we do it well.

● Collaborative: We are flexible, thoughtful and team players.

● Curious: We never stop learning from our clients, colleagues, and partners.

● Inclusive: We embrace all voices and backgrounds; it enriches our work.

Profile.

Many of our people have backgrounds in government, philanthropy, think tanks, policy research, and non-profits. Some come from startups and tech. Our Delivery Leaders generally have already 5-8 years in other organizations and often have experience with our major verticals: climate, education, health, government innovation. But we’ve done this long enough to know that what matters most is your skill set and your mindset. We are open to lots of backgrounds as long as you can show us you’re an analytical thinker, a clear communicator, a team player, and an avid learner.

Required Experience.

These are the basics.

● Bachelor’s degree or equivalent requisite experiences; Masters degree is a plus.

● A minimum of 5-8 years of relevant, full time work experience in government, consulting, public policy, project management and/or impact measurement

● Business level proficiency in English; Spanish proficiency is highly desirable.

● Expertise in data analysis and facilitation of trainings and workshops to enhance data capacity in governments.

● Experience working in the standard business suite (analyzing data in spreadsheets, creating presentations, etc)

● Based in Recife for the remaining of 2025; after that, based in Brazil with willingness to travel up to 25-40% and be accessible to an airport.

● Must be based in and have work authorization to work in Brazil. Delivery Associates will not sponsor applicants for work visas.

● Availability to start as early as June 2025.

What we offer.

● Impactful work on transformative projects: Opportunities to engage with senior leaders working on the biggest challenges.

● Excellent colleagues: We strive to be as talent-dense and diverse as possible, so we are always learning from each other.

● Growth environment: Everyone’s career pathway is unique - be part of a growing organization committed to continuous improvement.

● Flexibility: Remote working environment with opportunities for global collaboration.

● Benefits Package: Our colleagues enjoy a comprehensive benefits package for the effort they put in. In Latin America, this means a market-rate base salary, annual bonus eligibility, private medical insurance, and generous paid leave balances (including 40 days of PTO.

● Travel opportunities: Our teams regularly come together to collaborate with each other, with clients, and in the communities our work is designed to impact.

About Delivery Associates:

We help governments, foundations, and social impact organizations all over the world turn big ideas, campaign promises, and ambitious goals into everyday reality for the people they serve. With over ten years of experience and expert staff guiding our work, Delivery Associates has delivered impact in areas ranging from education reform in the US to microfinance in South America to agricultural reform in Africa and the Middle East. We approach every problem with a strong bias towards implementation, an open mind to possibilities, empathy for governments and residents, and a strong values system. We are always asking ourselves, our partners, and our clients: What would it take to make change happen?

To learn more about Delivery Associates please visit deliveryassociates.com/our-work or contact our talent team at for more information on opportunities to join our team.

description:
If digital transformation , next generation technology and growth opportunities excite you, then apply to join our Netcracker Technology Team! Our culture and collaborative work environment are the keys to our success. Here you will work with the best in class global teams , earn a competitive salary and contribute to the largest digital transformations happening around the world.

What is in it for you?

At Netcracker, we are all entrepreneurs. This means we get creative when thinking of technical solutions, we explore possibilities and innovations and get excited about new technology. We take complete ownership of our roles and aren’t micromanaged or left feeling like just another number. The results we achieve are highly visible to our leadership team and we are recognized for our work and promoted accordingly.

What is the scope of this role?

As part of Finance Global Business Support, the Financial Reporting Analyst of Business Profitability Management will provide financial reporting and operational support to Senior Management, Regional General Managers and supporting organizations. Main responsibility is to provide transparency and trustworthy reporting for incoming deals and ongoing projects to help senior management make strategic and tactical decisions for the company. Candidate will be responsible for accuracy in financial reporting, mainly concentrating on actuals and forecast to allow successful completion of strategic initiatives to continuously improve company’s profitability and efficiency. In this role, candidate will work closely with operational groups indicating trends, findings, issues and steps needed to ensure data accuracy in the systems and reporting. Additionally, candidate will assist in driving business process and system enhancements related to all aspects of global business to streamline internal processes.

What are the Role and Responsibilities?

  • Global Business Consolidation reporting, analytics and distribution to Executives and Senior Management
  • Support monthly forecasting, actuals and variance analysis
  • Prepare KPI Decks and present all significant bookings, revenue and profit risks to Senior Management
  • Partnering with BPM Managers and analysts on a global scale to identify trends and issues requiring data adjustments to properly reflect Customer Booking, Revenue and Profitability Forecast
  • Review and evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of internal processes and manage risk by identifying opportunities to strengthen, rewrite and implement new risk conscious business processes
  • Define business requirements, test and implement an extensive ERP-based automated profitability reporting and analysis tool that enhances the accuracy, flexibility and timeliness of profitability forecasting
  • Perform ad-hoc reports and analysis as needed

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Strong financial analysis skills with ability to manipulate large data sets in Excel (knowledge of Macros preferred)
  • Experience in Data Analytics , ability to extrapolate trends from large data sets
  • 3+ years combined experience in Financial/Business Operations
  • Profitability / P&L analysis and reporting experience
  • Accounting (US GAAP/IFRS ) and Revenue Recognition experience a plus
  • Proficient in PowerBI or other BI tools
  • Hands-on experience in SQL, VBA, Big Data Analytics
  • Experience in use of ERP systems
  • Experience working in large multinational software and/or IT services company
  • A team player, with ability to work independently, as well as cross-functionally at all levels including interfacing with Senior Management
  • Robust communication skills both verbal and written
  • Ability to meet deadlines and satisfy needs with multiple and conflicting priorities
  • Fluent English both written and oral
  • Availability to work from office in Hybrid mode

Who is Netcracker Technology?
We are a forward-looking software company, offering mission-critical solutions to service providers around the globe. Our comprehensive portfolio of software solutions and professional services enables large-scale digital transformations, unlocking the opportunities of the cloud, analytics, virtualization, and 5G mobile networks. With an unbroken service delivery track record of more than 25 years, our unique combination of technology, people and expertise helps companies transform their networks and enable better experiences for their customers.

title: Veterinary Technician
description:
Overview

Now Hiring: Full-Time Veterinary Technician Eastern Market – Washington, DC Three 10-hour shifts per week + every other Saturday $22–$27/hour, based on experience and licensure

About the Role

We’re growing our team and looking for a dedicated Full-Time Veterinary Technician who’s passionate about animal care and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. This is a great opportunity to join a close-knit, supportive hospital that values high-quality medicine and low-stress patient handling.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

At our AAHA-accredited hospital, we believe in a team-first culture where coworkers feel more like family. We offer: A positive, supportive work environment Opportunities to grow, learn, and make an impact A modern, well-organized facility $100/month in Metro benefits A convenient schedule – 3 ten-hour weekdays + every other Saturday (4-day workweek!)

Location Perks

Located just one block from the Metro (Orange, Blue, and Silver lines), we’re nestled in the heart of the vibrant Eastern Market neighborhood. With plenty of nearby shops, restaurants, and cafes, it’s a fun and convenient place to work—and unwind after your shift.

What You'll Do

You’ll support a variety of services including:

  • Soft tissue surgeries

  • Laser therapy

  • Ultrasound procedures

  • Low-stress handling techniques

  • AAHA-accredited protocols

You’ll also work with modern tools and systems like Scribenote (AI charting), Vet FM software , and Abaxis in-house lab equipment to keep your workflow efficient.

What We’re Looking For

1–2 years of veterinary experience preferred Proficient in medical terminology, venipuncture, and surgical/anesthesia support Comfortable with vaccination protocols and clinical procedures Licensure preferred but not required—compensation reflects your experience and credentials

Ready to Apply?

We’d love to hear from you! Send us your resume and take the next step in your veterinary career with a team that values your passion and experience.

Responsibilities

Major Duties:

  • Our Veterinary Technicians are responsible for in-patient medical care- administer medications, assist or perform treatments, diagnostics & monitoring, place IV catheters, draw blood, run lab tests, administer IV fluids, cleaning, feeding, and walking patients as needed.
  • Anesthesia/Surgery – Our Veterinary Technician's prep, induction, maintenance, monitoring, recovery of patients, cleans/maintains/sterilize anesthesia equipment and surgical instruments.
  • Dentistry- Our Veterinary Technician's provide patient dental care, ultrasonic cleaning and polishing, assist doctor with dental surgery.
  • Radiology - Our Veterinary Technician's position patients and assist with radiographs, sending radiographs via email.
  • Laboratory duties- Our Veterinary Technicians are responsible for collecting, preparing, & running or submitting samples for requested tests; reading and recording results when indicated (fecals, Urines, Ear cytology etc) when requested by doctor.
  • Preparing invoices, discharge instructions, and client informational tools
  • Client communication for hospitalized patients - give patient updates, discharge instructions, and provide follow up for certain hospital patients.
  • Client medical demonstrations / education - teach/educate clients on at home care procedures.
  • Veterinary Technician appointments- blood draws for therapeutic monitoring / screening tests, bandage changes, post-op checks, suture removals, AG, TNT.
  • Clinic technician- assisting doctor with outpatient appointments, preparing, restocking, cleaning exam room, check patients in and out, take history and vitals, input data into patient medical record, ensure a smooth and timely flow of outpatient appointments from check-in to discharge.
  • Assist with reception/front desk duties as needed- answering phones, booking appointments, admit/discharge patients.
  • Assist in training and mentoring new team members.
  • Assist with inventory control – informing inventory manager when products are getting low/out, unpacking, restocking drug & medical supplies.
  • Preparing prescriptions - dispensed medications & medication refills.

Qualifications

Physical Requirements:

  • The veterinary technician must have the ability to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, crouch, and climb as well as manipulate (lift, carry, move) up to 50 pounds and over 50 pounds with a coworker.
  • The veterinary technician must be able to endure sitting, standing and walking on hard floor surfaces for extended periods of time.
  • The veterinary technician must possess sufficient ambulatory skills to perform duties while in hospital environment.
  • The veterinary technician must be able to work in noisy work conditions with sounds from animals and equipment that can be moderately high.
  • The veterinary technician will be routinely exposed to a variety of pets that may bite or scratch, and on occasion, exposed to anesthesia, radiation, biological hazards, and medication/controlled substances.

description:
No Grupo Ramasa, valorizamos o comprometimento com a excelência. Se você é um profissional com brilho nos olhos e apaixonado pelo que faz, acreditamos que, com sua experiência e paixão, você não só contribuirá para o nosso sucesso contínuo, mas também se tornará uma peça fundamental no crescimento e na evolução da nossa organização. Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

  • Supervisionar, treinar e motivar a equipe, estabelecendo metas claras e acompanhando seu desempenho.
  • Realizar reuniões periódicas com a equipe para discutir estratégias, metas e resultados.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de vendas alinhadas com os objetivos da concessionária e da montadora.
  • Analisar o mercado, a concorrência e as tendências do setor para identificar oportunidades de crescimento.
  • Garantir um alto nível de satisfação dos clientes, promovendo um atendimento de qualidade e personalizado.
  • Resolver problemas e reclamações de clientes de maneira eficiente e satisfatória.
  • Promover a fidelização de clientes através de programas de relacionamento e follow-up pós-venda.
  • Utilizar ferramentas e sistemas para monitorar e analisar os dados de vendas.
  • Identificar áreas de melhoria e propor ações corretivas quando necessário.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de marketing para desenvolver campanhas promocionais e eventos de vendas.
  • Participar ativamente na promoção da marca e dos produtos da concessionária.
  • Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Marketing, Gestão Comercial ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência em cargos de gestão de vendas, preferencialmente no setor automotivo.

Fundado em 1976, o Grupo Ramasa tem sua história edificada por relacionamentos duradouros, norteado pela consolidação de marcas comprometidas com a geração sustentável de valor.

O Grupo se ramifica por diversos estados do Brasil: Goiás, Distrito Federal, Mato Grosso, Tocantins, Pará, Pernambuco e Alagoas, com atuação nos segmentos da construção civil, hotelaria, logística (armazenagem, aduana e gestão dos modais ferroviário, rodoviário e aeroviário), agronegócio e automotivo.

A incursão no segmento automotivo teve início no ano de 1992, com a Lince, concessionária Toyota pioneira em Goiás. A marca Nissan se juntou ao Grupo no ano de 2010, com a abertura das concessionárias Katana. O ano de 2017 foi marcado pelo reforço das inglesas Jaguar e Land Rover, que se integrarem ao Grupo Ramasa, com a Silver Motors. E, mais recentemente, 2023, o Grupo trouxe aos seus negócios a marca inglesa de motocicletas Triumph, com a Silver Motocicletas.

No mesmo ano, a holding Ramasa inaugurou a divisão Ramasa Auto, um novo braço de negócios dedicado exclusivamente à expansão dos empreendimentos e iniciativas do segmento automotivo.

A Ramasa Auto é movida pela tradição e inovação do DNA Toyota, pela ousadia confiável da marca Nissan, com o reforço de originalidade e luxo das inglesas Jaguar, Land Rover e Triumph. A qualidade, dínamo de excelência, no motiva.

Ao longo desse meio século de existência, o cuidado com os clientes, colaboradores, fornecedores, meio ambiente, sociedade e acionistas garantiu a perenidade do Grupo Ramasa, uma das empresas mais sólidas e respeitadas de Goiás.

Nutrimos o objetivo de perene fomento a negócios confiáveis, lucrativos e duradouros para todos os nossos clientes e parceiros comerciais, buscando impactar cada vez mais positivamente as diversas cidades onde atuamos.

Neste trilhar, cumprimos nosso propósito de construir um legado de pioneirismo, responsabilidade e crescimento sustentável que honre o caminho já percorrido até aqui, inspirando as próximas gerações.

Company Description


Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

More aboutour mission andwhat we offer .


Job Description


Strategically guide the Due Diligence Team to achieve operational goals and maximize business impact. The primary focus will be on people development, processes enhancement, and productivity management. Your overall objective is to analyze data, behaviors, maintain morale, and drive for sustainable results that are aligned with the KYC Department’s strategy and goals.

Duties and responsibilities:

  • Evaluate your team’s performance, both on an individual and team level ensuring team members adhere to company and department policies while achieving their individual and team goals.
  • Develop and maintain team performance metrics consistent with the KYC department goals, and track performance of said goals.

  • Foster an inclusive and engaging environment to ensure the morale and productivity of your team.
  • Contribute to the growth of your team through forecasting, strategizing and hiring.
  • Bring a client-focused and holistic approach to decision making to identify the root cause of issues.
  • Manage several projects simultaneously with a sense of urgency while working with partners and stakeholders.
  • Identify strategies to continually improve the client experience and ensure your team strives for the highest standards of performance.
  • Liaison with cross teams to ensure procedures are up to date, negotiating where possible to ensure the client experience is prioritized while adhering to regulatory requirements.
  • Deliver key measurables in a timely, professional and ethical manner to ensure dependability and sustainability of results.
  • Drive continuous improvements to quality of data, productivity reporting and associated metrics to improve and maximize the KYC strategy.
  • As needed, represent the Due Diligence team in multiple forums, internally and externally, to provide transparency on initiatives.

Qualifications


  • At least 1 year of experience as a team lead in the compliance field
  • You have strong verbal & written English and Portuguese skills
  • Able to articulate our vision clearly and passionately, ensuring your team understands how their individual efforts contribute to higher level goals.
  • Demonstrate the behavior that you want people to follow. Aligning your words and actions will help to build trust and make your team more willing to follow your example.
  • Able to communicate clearly, concisely and tactfully will be a crucial skill to inspire and energize your staff.
  • Effective leader; Making fast, difficult decisions with limited information in critical situations.
  • Drive the due diligence team forward with passion, enthusiasm, inspiration and motivation, investing time in the people to determine their strengths, needs, and priorities.
  • Able to find ways to celebrate the achievements of teammates, even if it’s through a simple ‘well done.’ As well as boosting morale, it will also strengthen motivation to continue supporting teammates to deliver their best work.

Additional Information


  • Please apply by submitting your resume in English. Applications in Portuguese will not be considered.
  • This is a hybrid position located in Sao Paulo, and not fully remote. You must be able to commute to the office or be open to relocation.
  • You must already be legally authorized to work in São Paulo, Brazil.

Benefits:

  • Salary for this role is 10,500 BRL per month, plus benefits, and RSUs.
  • RSUs in a rapidly growing company.
  • Flexible working model – During the first six months, you’ll be in office most days of the week to become fully immersed in Wise’s culture and ways of working. After the initial period, you’ll be in office at least 3 days per week.
  • An annual self-development budget.
  • Health and dental allowance for you and your dependents.
  • Company-paid: Life Insurance, and an EAP program.
  • Paid time off: 30 days vacation + 3 “Me” days + 1 volunteer day, annually.
  • A paid 6-week sabbatical leave after four years.
  • 18-weeks of paid parental leave, after a year with us and child care assistance.
  • Transportation vouchers.
  • Meal (708 BRL per month) and food (1,166 BRL per month) vouchers.
  • TotalPass access to 3,500 gyms and studios throughout Brazil.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

Sobre nós

Sobre a Oportunidade

Estamos construindo um banco de talentos para nossa área de Estratégia e Performance (Business Analytics). Se você tem paixão por dados e deseja atuar em projetos estratégicos que impactam diretamente o crescimento da XP Inc., queremos te conhecer! O Que Procuramos

Pré-requisitos Essenciais:

  • Formação em Engenharias, Estatística, Administração, Economia, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com análise de dados, modelagem estatística e construção de dashboards.

  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para interação com diferentes áreas.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em Python ou R para manipulação e análise de dados.
  • Vivência no setor financeiro.
  • Experiência com Big Data e ferramentas na nuvem (AWS, GCP, Azure).

Desafios e Impacto:

  • Desenvolver análises estratégicas e dashboards para apoiar decisões de negócios.
  • Trabalhar com times multidisciplinares para impulsionar projetos de crescimento e eficiência operacional.
  • Estruturar e otimizar processos de coleta e análise de dados, garantindo insights mais precisos e ágeis.
  • Apoiar a criação de modelos preditivos e métricas que contribuam para a estratégia da XP Inc.

Etapas do Processo:

  1. Triagem inicial: Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.
  2. Testes gerais: Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.
  3. Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento: Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.
  4. Avaliação técnica: Teste focado nas habilidades específicas necessárias para a função.
  5. Entrevista com a liderança: Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.
  6. Entrevista com colegas de trabalho: Interação com futuros pares para avaliar a sinergia e o trabalho em equipe.
  7. Entrevista focada em cultura: Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.
  8. Oferta: Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade:

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura.
